mission_08: Fantastic! You have implemented comprehensive energy optimization for AI inference. Your energy model quantifies the cost of different operations based on real hardware measurements, revealing that off-chip memory access dominates energy consumption. The quantization optimizer finds the sweet spot between precision and accuracy, while the sparsity optimizer reduces computation by pruning unnecessary weights. Together, these techniques can reduce inference energy by 10-100x: 8-bit quantization alone saves 18x on MAC operations, 50% sparsity halves the compute, and keeping weights on-chip (SRAM vs DRAM) saves 250x on memory access. These optimizations are essential for deploying AI on battery-powered edge devices, from smartphones to IoT sensors to autonomous vehicles.
